The first published alpha of Cadence — the ambient context layer for Claude Code.

- `<user_state>` injection on every prompt: signals → four independent dials (pace, tone, posture, proactivity) → a reframe lens that always defers to your literal words
- Signals: music vibe (OS now-playing + MusicBrainz, no auth), ambient (time/day, opt-in weather, battery, Focus/DND, dark mode, displays, wifi), git work-state with live nudges (3+ commits/hr → fast pace, mid-conflict → verify-first), activity (prompt gap/length), self-report (`cadence state`, with TTL)
- Conservative Stop hook: blocks soft handoffs only with explicit shipping authority
- PostToolUse hook: speaks once per merge/rebase conflict transition
- CLI: `cadence state | test | signals | dials | set/unset | set-location | start`
- Claude Code plugin packaging with `/cadence:try` and `/cadence:state` skills

macOS-only alpha; other platforms degrade to self-report + dials + time/git.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cullumco/cadence
